title: EventLens: Event-Structure Reinforcement Learning for Video Understanding
abstract: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong results on video question answering, yet often fail to recover the temporal structure that makes a video coherent. They may merge neighboring events, miss single-event progression, or infer implausible relations across events. We study structured temporal understanding as the ability to recover event structure from visual evidence, including event boundaries, single-event progression, and multi-event relations. We argue that this gap arises from a mismatch between current post-training objectives and temporal reasoning, where caption-style supervision allows models to rely on language shortcuts rather than visual temporal grounding. To address this, we propose EventLens, a vision-centric reinforcement learning framework that learns video understanding through event-structure recovery. Instead of reconstructing captions, EventLens trains models to recover temporal structure under controlled perturbations, such as altered temporal granularity, reversed progression, and shuffled event order. We instantiate this framework with a three-level temporal ontology and derive three verifiable task families: event segmentation, progression discrimination, and multi-event relation reasoning. These tasks admit deterministic rewards, enabling task-specialized GRPO training without human preference labels or learned reward models. We further introduce multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MT-OPD) to consolidate specialized policies into a unified model. Experiments on Qwen3-VL backbones show consistent improvements on temporal grounding and event-sensitive reasoning benchmarks, while preserving general video-QA performance. Learning curves further demonstrate that EventLens achieves comparable downstream transfer with significantly reduced training cost compared to direct mixed RL optimization.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2610.16172v1 的 22 页全文与关键图表核验。实验数字与比较均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态：promised。
analysis.ideaZh: EventLens 将 video understanding 训练为 event structure recovery：按 phase/event/action 层级做边界分割、正反时序判断与多事件关系恢复，先训练 specialized GRPO teachers，再用 MT-OPD 统一学生。作者报告 temporal grounding 最稳定提升，广义 QA 与长程叙事并非全面增强；效率图只计 student 阶段，不能抹去 teacher 成本。
analysis.motivationZh: video MLLM 可识别大意却常混淆 event boundaries、内部 progression 和多事件依赖，caption-style supervision 无法针对这些结构。
analysis.methodZh: EventLens 将 video understanding 训练为 event structure recovery：按 phase/event/action 层级做边界分割、正反时序判断与多事件关系恢复，先训练 specialized GRPO teachers，再用 MT-OPD 统一学生。作者报告 temporal grounding 最稳定提升，广义 QA 与长程叙事并非全面增强；效率图只计 student 阶段，不能抹去 teacher 成本。
methodFlow: source videos 构建 three-level temporal ontology
扰动 event boundaries/progression/order 并构造可验证恢复目标
三类 GRPO teachers 分别学各 reward family
按 task family 路由 teacher top-k logits 作 sparse KL consolidation
analysis.experimentsZh: TimeLens100K/ET-Instruct164K 官方 train partitions 构造 proxy tasks；Qwen3-VL4B/8B 及 Qwen2.5-VL7B；统一 256frames/max256×256 protocol。 以下结果为作者报告：作者报告 Qwen3-VL8B QVHighlights mIoU50.03 到 59.12、Charades44.79 到 48.25；同模型 LongVideoBench57.97 到 56.77，并非所有 retention 指标提升。（Tables 1-2, p. 8） 对照范围：包含 base、SFT-Desc、SFT-DVC、Video-R1、direct mixed EMA-GRPO 及 single-teacher comparisons；跨 family 数字需按各自 protocol 解读。 消融与诊断：Tables4-6 测 teacher 组合、capability recovery 与 10/20%timestamp perturbation；relation teacher 不支配所有 retention 指标。
analysis.insightZh: 以共享 temporal ontology 连接互补恢复任务，并将异质稀疏 reward 拆成 specialization 与 dense on-policy consolidation。
analysis.evidenceZh: segment F1-style tIoU、forward/reverse binary 和 event selection/permutation 各有确定性 reward。（Secs. 3.1-3.2, pp. 4-6）；MT-OPD 在 student 轨迹上路由对应 teacher 的 top-k next-token distributions。（Sec. 3.4; Fig. 2, pp. 4,7）；作者报告 Qwen3-VL8B QVHighlights mIoU50.03 到 59.12、Charades44.79 到 48.25；同模型 LongVideoBench57.97 到 56.77，并非所有 retention 指标提升。（Tables 1-2, p. 8）
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 训练目标推进 video MLLM 对时序结构的 grounding/reasoning，而非把传统 action recognition 误归 video generation。
analysis.caveatZh: 渐变 event 或高层 activity 跨多个 atomic actions 时会混淆边界。；重复动作依赖细微 context，仍未解决 long-range narrative reasoning。；Fig.4 约 13h vs37h 为 MT-OPD student 阶段，未自动包含预训练全部 teachers。；public GitHub 仅项目网站，README 明确 training code 待发布，不能提供 available Code link。
